subject: Experiments
source_sentence: Experiments on the YouCookII dataset (a cooking-domain instruc- tional video corpus) are conducted to show that our model can achieve state -of-the-art results and the ablation studies demonstrate that the transcript can not only improve procedure proposition per- formance but also be very effective for procedure captioning .

subject: BERT
source_sentence: To embed transcripts, we first split all tokens in the transcript by a sliding window and input them into a uncased BERT-large model.
title: Dense Procedure Captioning in Narrated Instructional Videos

subject: Transformer
source_sentence: Next, we encode these sentences by a Transformer and take the first output as the context-aware transcript embedding e ∈Re.
title: Dense Procedure Captioning in Narrated Instructional Videos

subject: Transformer
source_sentence: Then we adopt another Transformer model to further encode the context information, and output X = {x1, · · ·, xT } ∈RT×d.
title: Dense Procedure Captioning in Narrated Instructional Videos

subject: Bi-directional LSTM
source_sentence: Finally, we combine each of the frame features in X with transcript feature e to get the fused feature C = {c1, · · ·, ct, · · ·, cT |ct = {xt ◦e}} and feed it into a Bi-directional LSTM in order to encode past and future contextual information of video frames: F = Bi-LSTM(C) where F = {f1 · · · fT } ∈ RT×f, and f is the hidden size of the LSTM layers.
